title: The prescribed completed mixed unit represents finite scalar extension
statement: Let ell be a prime, E and L finite extensions of Q_ell, iota:E→L a Q_ell-algebra homomorphism, and W a scheme on which ell is invertible. For any unbounded derived module K over the completed E-coefficient sheaf and n≥0, write A_n and B_n for the actual E and L coefficient quotient rings at exponent n+1, and R for derived restriction along integralScalarQuotientMap [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Set N to finite L-reduction of completed scalar extension of K. For every unbounded derived B_n-module Z, composition with the specified sfMixedCompletedReductionUnit [def-weil-mixed-reduction-unit] gives a bijection Hom(N,Z)→Hom(K_n,RZ). There is no compactification or operation in this assertion.

source.place: Compact-support paragraph and final paragraph; first normalization step, before inverse compact-support reduction

proof.text: Use the coherent reduction comparison: its counit and inverse tensor association identify N with derived finite extension of K_n. Compute the ordinary mixed unit on flat-term K-flat representatives as s tensor x ↦ iota(s) tensor (1 tensor x). Scalar association carries it to the finite extension/restriction unit.

The completed factor is the diagonal Roos augmentation with zero shifted coordinate. Strict Roos comparison preserves its actual limit projections, and the effectivity counit is the adjunct of those projections. Hence the same comparison carries the entire completed mixed unit to the finite scalar unit. Resolution comparisons and localization extend this equality to all K.

Transport Hom by the comparison isomorphism and then apply the derived coefficient adjunction. Its Hom equivalence is composition with the finite scalar unit, and is defined for every unbounded target Z. Thus its transported equivalence is exactly the displayed function.

theorem sfMixedCompletedReductionHomBijective
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) (W : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E W)) (n : ℕ)
    (Z : proEtaleDerivedCategory W (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))) :
    Function.Bijective (fun a :
      (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l L W n).obj
        ((integralScalarExtension l E L ι W).obj K) ⟶ Z ↦
      sfMixedCompletedReductionUnit l E L ι W n K ≫
        (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars W
          (integralScalarQuotientMap l E L ι n)).mapDerivedCategory.map a)
